transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: Thanks Elena. Shall we start with the rollout order for the three new clinics?

transcript.speaker: speaker_02
transcript.text: Riverside first, then Northgate and Cedar Hills two weeks apart.

transcript.speaker: speaker_03
transcript.text: That works. Each clinic needs about a week for template setup and front-desk training.

transcript.speaker: speaker_02
transcript.text: The open question is security. Sam's team has to sign off before any clinic goes live, because the intake forms carry PHI.

transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: We'll need a BAA signed as part of that review. Should we reach out to Sam directly?

transcript.speaker: speaker_02
transcript.text: Let me introduce you to Sam - he'll want to set the agenda himself.

transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: Sounds good. We'll have the BAA template and HIPAA controls summary ready.
